changes.title: Ed layout update
items: Ed's latest treehouse arrangement has its cauldron and nine mushroom baskets in Dining. Potion smoke affects witches in that room.

changes.title: Telephone panel
items: Calling friends is still being prepared. The telephone's usual quiet-line message is unchanged.

changes.title: Chain path mushroom glow
items: Travelling animals’ chains settle onto their routes and lift back to the sigil when they rejoin.
Wild mushrooms cast a stronger glow in their own colour.
Wild stump stacks show the fighters left to invite. Once clear, the whole stack appears and the soundsystem note is visible from afar.
The terrain draws beneath the great stumps and other ground artwork.
